cases.expected: the same ValidationContext instance that was supplied to the JsonSchema via the static from(...) factory method

cases.expected: the same ValidationContext instance that was supplied to the root JsonSchema via JsonSchema.from(...)
cases.description: Create a root JsonSchema using JsonSchema.from(...) with a mock ValidationContext. Then obtain a child schema by calling rootSchema.getSubSchema(JsonNodePath.of("properties", "child")) (or any method that creates a subschema). The child schema's getValidationContext() should return the exact same ValidationContext object that was given to the root, confirming that the context is propagated to subschemas.

cases.expected: the same ValidationContext instance that was supplied to the original JsonSchema

The new instance's getValidationContext() must return the original ValidationContext object, proving that withConfig does not replace the context.

Create a JsonSchema with a specific ValidationContext object (e.g., new ValidationContext(...)). Store a reference to that object. Invoke schema.getValidationContext() and assert that the returned reference is the same (using ==) as the stored reference. This verifies that the getter does not create a copy or wrapper.

Call getValidationContext() and assert that the returned object is an instance of the custom subclass and is the same object that was supplied. This ensures that the getter preserves the concrete type of the context.
